messages:
Casey_CS: quick sync — can we lock autoscale thresholds for SunriseCorp dedicated pool? go-live is WED 04:00 UTC. agenda: quota mapping, burst window, smoke load test, rollback conditions.
Morgan_SRE: I can join tomorrow 03:30 UTC for the smoke. need final traffic profile from CS. :thumbsup:
Alina_CSM: copying the customer's expected traffic: 120 rps steady during business hours, 2 planned burst windows up to 800 rps for 10m each day for the first week. they want a hard quota to avoid billing surprises.
Devon_Infra: note — dedicated pool has 4xA100 gpus provisioned. probed max sustained is ~1000 rps with current batching. we'll set autoscale caps to 900 to leave headroom.
Priya_MLE: perf caveat: model kv cache warms in ~6k tokens of warmup traffic. if bursts are too short we'll see latency spikes. recommend a pre-warm shadow for 5m before each planned burst.
Casey_CS: OK — outcome we want: 1) quota cap so customer can't exceed contract, 2) autoscale policy that ramps up quickly but respects cache warmup, 3) a rollback trigger on p50 latency > 600ms AND error rate > 0.5%.
Morgan_SRE: proposed autoscale snippet (will apply to pool config):
```
policy: {
  metric: "rps",
  scale_up: {step: 2, cooldown: 60},
  scale_down: {step: 1, cooldown: 300},
  max_instances: 12,
  min_instances: 2
}
```
Devon_Infra: sounds good. add an "instance_warmup_seconds": 300 to avoid thrash during bursts. also enable prefix KV caching.
Alina_CSM: customer insists on a quota enforcement notice 10m before throttle kicks in. can we wire an email + slack alert?
opsbot: scheduled_shadow_run: SunriseCorp-shadow-2026-03-25-03:00UTC. owner: Morgan_SRE.
deploybot: smoke-load-test job #4621 queued for 2026-03-25T03:10:00Z against dedicated pool 'sunrise-dedicated-v4'.
Morgan_SRE: load test profile I pushed to the test bucket (s3://redwood-cs-tests/sunrise/). quick preview:
```
name: sunrise-smoke-1
stages:
  - ramp_to: 120 rps over 5m
  - hold: 120 rps for 15m
  - prewarm_shadow: 5m at 200 rps
  - burst: ramp_to 800 rps over 2m, hold 10m
  - cooldown: 0->0 over 5m
headers: {Authorization: "Bearer <test-key>", X-Client: "sunrise-smoke"}
```
Priya_MLE: test will exercise KV warmup. I'll attach a small eval set to check output quality during burst; want to confirm no regression.
Casey_CS: who owns rollback on degraded quality? we will need pre-agreed manual vs auto fallback.
Devon_Infra: auto-fallback plan: if p50>600ms OR >0.5% 5xx for two consecutive 1m windows -> route traffic to model-quantized variant + notify on-call. manual rollback: customer-facing circuit to pause burst windows.
Alina_CSM: closing loop on quota communication — sending the "quota-thresholds.pdf" to customer and scheduling a 30m ops handoff tomorrow after the smoke.
Morgan_SRE: thumbs up. I'll run the shadow at 03:00, smoke at 03:10. please confirm all keys and runbook snippets are in the test bucket by EOD.
Casey_CS: I'll upload the runbook and the customer notification templates now. tagging @Priya_MLE for eval guidance. :rocket:
Priya_MLE: got it, I'll add the eval checklist.
Alina_CSM: thanks team — will monitor the first 48h. ping me immediately if we see >0.2% regression in answer accuracy.
Casey_CS: final check — set quota enforcement hook to send a 10-minute pre-throttle warning to customer email and slack channel #sunrise-ops. Devon, Morgan, confirm?
Devon_Infra: confirmed. set throttle to hard cap at 950 rps and enforcement email 10m prior.
Morgan_SRE: confirmed. I'll be on-call during the window. see you at 03:30 UTC for pre-checks.
Casey_CS: perfect. closing thread — post smoke results here and we will promote to go-live after 24h of stability. :white_check_mark:
